description: Alpine apk pin management for Dockerfiles via repology. Covers both '>=' lower-bound and '=' exact pins. The Alpine release below is hard-coded and nothing bumps it: when consumers move to a newer Alpine base image, 'alpine_3_24' has to be raised here in both the depNameTemplate and the matchPackageNames rule, or repology keeps resolving against the old branch.

customManagers.description: Bump every apk pin inside an 'apk add' block (>= lower-bound or = exact), including the -rN release suffix. The two-stage recursive match keeps the pattern from leaking into unrelated line continuations such as ENV blocks.
